answer: A slow ocean of fake identities drowns networks that answer in batches. Latency-bound attestation fixes it: each identity locks 500 POA on one device and answers a fresh challenge inside ninety seconds from it. Each epoch a bonded auditor pool deep-audits four percent of answers at random: device, location, timing must match or the bond slashes, half to the auditor. A thousand clones lock one million POA and fail the timing wall; expect forty audits and twenty thousand POA burned per epoch. Trust lands like a raven at dusk: one bird, one message; the relic of batch fraud stays buried.
